subject.title: fix(voice-call): persist assistant transcript on call.speaking events

question: Should this PR be narrowed to the voice-call transcript fix before merge, or should the boot-run session/memory changes remain in scope?
rationale: The voice transcript bug is source-reproducible, but the branch also changes boot prompt security and persisted session classification, which requires maintainer direction before a safe merge path exists.

options.title: Rebase And Narrow The Voice Fix
options.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, keep the voice transcript persistence focused, preserve live-call timeout and BOOT.md safeguards, prevent duplicate bot turns, and require redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Split Boot-Session Memory Work
options.body: Move the boot-run key, host SDK export, memory ingestion, and reaper changes to a separate maintainer-reviewed PR with targeted security and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause Until Real Proof Exists
options.body: Keep this PR blocked if the contributor cannot provide inspectable redacted live transcript evidence for the changed call path.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Narrow The Voice Fix
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, keep the voice transcript persistence focused, preserve live-call timeout and BOOT.md safeguards, prevent duplicate bot turns, and require redacted live proof before merge.
